description: A Perl script for flashing and managing firmware on D-Link DSL-502T routers, including firmware verification, MTD configuration, and device rebooting.

classes.name: ADAM2FTP
classes.description: A subclass of Net::FTP with custom methods for interacting with ADAM2 bootloader, including environment variable retrieval and reboot command.

methods.name: _USER
methods.description: Sends USER command to FTP server, ensuring uppercase command.

methods.name: _GETENV
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable from FTP server.

methods.name: getenv
methods.description: Public method to get environment variable.

methods.name: _REBOOT
methods.description: Sends REBOOT command to FTP server.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Public method to reboot the device.
